muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿عبس﴾: a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (he).
﴿وتولى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «تولى» is a past verb indeclinable on a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (he); the clause ﴿عبس﴾ is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), and the clause ﴿تولى﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿عبس﴾.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿أن﴾: maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya).
﴿جاءه﴾: a past verb, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar is accusative (manṣūb) by removal of the preposition.
﴿الأعمى﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of «جاء».

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «ما» is an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يدريك﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "anta" (you) [Translator's note: so in the source; the latent fāʿil of «يدريك» would more naturally be "huwa", referring back to «ما»]; and the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿لعله﴾: «لعل» is a particle of hope and of the accusative, and the hāʾ is its noun.
﴿يزكى﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "huwa" (he); the clause ﴿يزكي﴾ [sic in the source, for «يزكى»] is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿لعل﴾, and the clause ﴿لعله يزكى﴾ is in the position of an accusative, standing in place of the second and third objects of the verb ﴿يدريك﴾.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿أو﴾: a conjunction.
﴿يذكر﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "huwa" (he); the clause ﴿يذكر﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿يزكى﴾.
﴿فتنفعه﴾: the fāʾ is causal (sababiyya), and «تنفع» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by «أن» implied after the causal fāʾ; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar from «أن» and the verb is conjoined to a maṣdar understood from the preceding speech, i.e. "perhaps there will be with you a purification, and then a benefit".
﴿الذكرى﴾: the fāʿil of «تنفع», nominative by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿أما﴾: «أما» is a particle of condition and detailing.
﴿من﴾: a relative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿استغنى﴾: a past verb; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (he); the clause ﴿استغنى﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿فأنت﴾: an overt, detached pronoun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تصدى﴾.
﴿تصدى﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "anta" (you); the clause ﴿تصدى﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿أنت﴾.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «ما» is negating.
﴿عليك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿ألا﴾: «أن» is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya), and «لا» is negating.
﴿يزكى﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) [Translator's note: so in the source; after «أن» the verb is accusative, the fatḥa being implied on the alif]; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "huwa" (he); the interpreted maṣdar is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿وأما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «أما» is a particle of condition and detailing.
﴿من﴾: a relative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿جاءك﴾: a past verb; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿جاءك﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿يسعى﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (he); the clause ﴿يسعى﴾ is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of ﴿جاءك﴾.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿وهو﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «هو» is mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يخشى﴾: an imperfect verb; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (he); the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿فأنت﴾: the fāʾ is a particle in the apodosis of ﴿أما﴾, and «أنت» is a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿عنه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تلهى﴾.
﴿تلهى﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "anta" (you); the clause ﴿تلهى﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of «أنت», and the clause ﴿أنت عنه تلهى﴾ is the khabar of ﴿من﴾.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿كلا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke.
﴿إنها﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, and ﴿ها﴾ is its noun.
﴿تذكرة﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «إن», nominative (marfūʿ); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ is parenthetical, and «من» is a jussive-governing conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿شاء﴾: a past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (he).
﴿ذكره﴾: a past verb; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (he), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); it is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause is parenthetical between the thing described, namely His saying ﴿تذكرة﴾, and the description, namely His saying ﴿في صحف﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿في﴾: a preposition.
﴿صحف﴾: a noun in the genitive, the sign of its genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿تذكرة﴾.
﴿مكرمة﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿صحف﴾, genitive (majrūr).

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿مرفوعة﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿صحف﴾, genitive (majrūr).
﴿مطهرة﴾: a naʿt of ﴿صحف﴾, genitive.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿بأيدي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿صحف﴾.
﴿سفرة﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr).

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿كرام﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿سفرة﴾, genitive (majrūr).
﴿بررة﴾: a naʿt of ﴿سفرة﴾, genitive.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿قتل﴾: a past verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named).
﴿الإنسان﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿ما﴾: a complete indefinite (nakira tāmma) meaning "a great thing", in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أكفره﴾: a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; its fāʿil (agent) is a necessarily latent (mustatir wujūban) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (it); and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أكفره﴾ is in the position of a nominative, the khabar (predicate) of «ما»; and the clause ﴿قتل...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿من﴾: a preposition indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn.
﴿أي﴾: a noun in the genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خلقه﴾.
﴿شيء﴾: muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿خلقه﴾: «خلق» is a past verb indeclinable on fatḥa; its fāʿil (agent) is a necessarily latent (mustatir wujūban) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (He); and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿من﴾: a preposition indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn.
﴿نطفة﴾: a noun in the genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خلقه﴾, and ﴿من نطفة﴾ is a badal (substitute) from His saying ﴿من أي شيء﴾.
﴿خلقه﴾: «خلق» is a past verb indeclinable on fatḥa; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (He); and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فقدره﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «قدره» is a past verb indeclinable on fatḥa; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (He); and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence and delay.
﴿السبيل﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by preoccupation (ʿalā al-ishtighāl), by an implied (muqaddar) verb indicated by what follows it.
﴿يسره﴾: «يسر» is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (He); and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. The clause ﴿يسره﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence and delay.
﴿أماته﴾: «أمات» is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (He); and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فأقبره﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «أقبره» is a past verb indeclinable on fatḥa; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (He); and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿أقبره﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أماته﴾.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction.
﴿إذا﴾: an adverb (ẓarf) for future time, containing the meaning of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنشره﴾.
﴿شاء﴾: a past verb; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (He); the clause ﴿شاء﴾ is in the position of a genitive, the adverb being put in construct with it.
﴿أنشره﴾: a past verb; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (He), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أنشره﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the non-jussive condition.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿كلا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke.
﴿لما﴾: a jussive-governing particle of negation.
﴿يقض﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (he); the clause ﴿لما يقض...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ما﴾: a relative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿أمره﴾: a past verb; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (He), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿أمره﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿فلينظر﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, the lām is the lām of command, and «ينظر» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command.
﴿الإنسان﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma; the clause ﴿فلينظر الإنسان﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إلى﴾: a preposition.
﴿طعامه﴾: a noun in the genitive, and the hāʾ is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ينظر﴾.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿أنا﴾: «أن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun.
﴿صببنا﴾: a past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is a pronoun in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿صببنا﴾ is in the position of a nominative, khabar (predicate); and ﴿أنا صببنا﴾ is in the position of a genitive, a badal (substitute) from «طعامه».
﴿الماء﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿صبا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence with delay.
﴿شققنا﴾: a past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿الأرض﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb).
﴿شقا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative; the clause ﴿ثم شققنا﴾ is conjoined to the previous clause, in the position of a nominative.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿فأنبتنا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «أنبتنا» is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿فيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنبتنا﴾.
﴿حبا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿وعنبا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «عنبا» is a noun conjoined to ﴿حبا﴾, accusative (manṣūb).
﴿وقضبا﴾: conjoined to ﴿حبا﴾, accusative.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿وزيتونا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «زيتونا» is a noun conjoined to ﴿حبا﴾, accusative (manṣūb).
﴿ونخلا﴾: conjoined to ﴿حبا﴾, accusative.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿وحدائق﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «حدائق» is a noun conjoined to ﴿حبا﴾, accusative (manṣūb).
﴿غلبا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿حدائق﴾, accusative.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿وفاكهة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «فاكهة» is a noun conjoined to ﴿حبا﴾, accusative (manṣūb).
﴿وأبا﴾: conjoined to ﴿حبا﴾, accusative.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿متاعا﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative (manṣūb); or standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar), the implied form being: "He gives you provision".
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿متاعا﴾.
﴿ولأنعامكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and the lām is a preposition; «أنعامكم» is a noun in the genitive, and the pronoun is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿لأنعامكم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿لكم﴾.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿فإذا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive or a conjunction, the speech being resumptive with no grammatical position, or conjoined; «إذا» is an accusative adverb (ẓarf) of the future, containing the meaning of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted apodosis.
﴿جاءت﴾: a past verb, the tāʾ being for the feminine.
﴿الصاخة﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); the clause «جاءت» is in the position of a genitive, the adverb being put in construct with it.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿يوم﴾: a badal (substitute) from ﴿إذا﴾, accusative (manṣūb), i.e. "[the day] in which he flees".
﴿يفر﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿المرء﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative; the clause ﴿يفر﴾ is in the position of a genitive, the adverb being put in construct with it.
﴿من﴾: a preposition.
﴿أخيه﴾: a noun in the genitive by the yāʾ, because it is one of the six nouns; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يفر﴾.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿وأمه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «أمه» is a noun conjoined to ﴿أخيه﴾, genitive (majrūr) by the kasra.
﴿وأبيه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «أبيه» is a noun conjoined to ﴿أخيه﴾, genitive by the yāʾ.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿وصاحبته﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «صاحبته» is a noun conjoined to ﴿أخيه﴾, genitive (majrūr) by the kasra.
﴿وبنيه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «بنيه» is a noun conjoined to ﴿أخيه﴾, genitive by the yāʾ.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿لكل﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted nominative fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿امرئ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr).
﴿منهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿امرئ﴾, genitive.
﴿يومئذ﴾: «يوم» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), attached to the omitted khabar or attached to ﴿يغنيه﴾; and «إذٍ» is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on a sukūn implied (muqaddar) because its place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause.
﴿شأن﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿يغنيه﴾: an imperfect verb and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿يغنيه﴾ is a naʿt of ﴿شأن﴾, nominative.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿وجوه﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿يومئذ﴾: «يوم» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مسفرة﴾; and «إذٍ» is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on a sukūn implied (muqaddar) because its place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause.
﴿مسفرة﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿ضاحكة﴾: a second khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿مستبشرة﴾: a third khabar of ﴿وجوه﴾.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿ووجوه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «وجوه» is conjoined to the first ﴿وجوه﴾, nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿يومئذ﴾: «يوم» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عليها﴾ are attached; and «إذٍ» is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on a sukūn implied (muqaddar) because its place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause.
﴿عليها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar.
﴿غبرة﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; the clause ﴿عليها غبرة﴾ is in the position of a nominative, a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿وجوه﴾ or a second khabar of it.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿ترهقها﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿قترة﴾: a postponed fāʿil (agent), nominative; the clause ﴿ترهقها﴾ is in the position of a nominative, the khabar (predicate) of the second ﴿وجوه﴾.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿أولئك﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿هم﴾: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl).
﴿الكفرة﴾: the khabar (predicate) of ﴿أولئك﴾.
﴿الفجرة﴾: a second khabar of ﴿أولئك﴾. Or ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, «الكفرة» a first khabar and «الفجرة» a second khabar, and the clause is the khabar of ﴿أولئك﴾.
